Omit cover art, wordmarks, printed contents page, page numbers and US/US English tab bars; product name, model, printed version and cover contacts stay native.
FCC '--' measure markers become the shared FCC list; printed NOTE:/MODIFICATION: labels kept.
Warranty Period '3 Years Standard Warranty:' / '2 Years Extended Warranty:' prefixes become HB-WARRANTY-YEARS number, unit and label; body text unchanged.
Printed '⎓' DC symbol, degree signs and 'x' multiplication letters kept; '2×8020' kept only inside source art.
